headline: Senior React/Vue Developer — E-Commerce & Headless CMS

summary.p: Senior front-end developer with 15+ years building production React/Next.js and Vue/Nuxt applications. Strong background in e-commerce front-ends and headless CMS integrations (Contentful, Amplience), gained across enterprise projects for brands like Vans, The North Face, PUMA and Citizen Watches.

I write clean, well-tested, maintainable UI code and enjoy working closely with designers and other developers to ship polished user experiences. I use Claude Code and sub-agents to move fast, reviewing every diff myself before it ships.

Outside of client work I build and maintain my own Nuxt 3 site end-to-end (saltylens.art) - front-end, marketing pages, SEO and deployment. Also been experimenting with Shopify's headless Hydrogen framework as a personal learning project.

bullets: Architected and built front-end features for citizenwatch.com using React (PWA Kit), integrated with Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Contentful CMS.
Implemented Contentful content models and schemas
Built the front-end for an AI-assisted agentic gifting platform.
Shipped the AI chat interface, calendar views and new features using AI-assisted ('vibe coding') workflows to move fast.

experience.role: Technical Architect | Front End | CMS Tech Lead
bullets: Hands-on front-end developer building e-commerce storefronts with React and Vue for global brands including Vans, The North Face, Columbia Sportswear, Timberland, PUMA, Life Fitness and Zermatt Matterhorn Tourism.
Integrations between headless React/Vue front-ends with SFCC and enterprise CMS platforms (Contentful, Amplience).
Built and implemented CMS content models and schemas for e-commerce content across several projects.
Contributed to an SFCC accelerator built with React PWA Kit and Agnostic storefront using Vue
Delivered front-end for 19 brands (including Jack & Jones, Vero Moda, Only) across 3,000+ stores in 70 countries, on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware).
Built the Vero Moda website redesign.
Built front-end features for UK/EU retail clients (SCS, Vertu Global, Scotch & Soda) in a fast-paced agency environment.
Built promotional campaigns for SCS that drove up to 400% sales growth over Christmas/New Year 2015.
Built HTML5, CSS and JS mobile web-views used across different apps and devices, for the largest online real estate company in the Netherlands (funda.nl, ~8M hits/day).
Developed and maintained the mobile website m.funda.nl.

experience.role: Full Stack Lead Web Developer  |  Sydney
bullets: Built features for news.ninemsn.com.au, the leading news portal of Australia, working in scrum teams.
Built online marketing campaigns for several NineMSN clients.
Built the London Olympics 2012 Gamification Campaign, where users scored points by sharing articles and earned badges.
Participated in company-wide Hack Days (Hackathons) for 100+ developers, designers and data analysts.
